source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Record the time and date of the accident.
3. Input the names, jobs, and departments of those involved.
4. Describe the location where accident occurred.
5. Detail the sequence of events leading up to the accident.
6. Record the exact nature and extent of any injuries or damages.
7. Document any first aid or medical treatment administered.
8. Record the names and contact information of witnesses.
9. Include statements from the injured worker and any witnesses.
10. Notate any hazardous conditions identified and if they contributed to the accident.
11. Record actions taken to contain the situation and prevent similar accidents.
12. Notate details about the reporting and corrective actions taken in response to the incident. 
13. Attach any photos or drawings of the accident scene, broken equipment, and injuries. 
14. Include any formal reports completed for the incident, like OSHA reports.
15. Retain all documentation in a secure location with restricted access.
16
